sentences.text:
Author: Sushil Kukreja
Bench: Sushil Kukreja
Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:Hhc:10687-Db )

In The High Court Of Himachal Pradesh,
Shimla Rfa No. 272 of 2013 Reserved on: 29.10.2024 Decided on: 05.11.2024

General Manager,
Northern Railway ....Appellant Versus Dev Rattani & others ...

Respondents Coram:
The Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sushil Kukreja, Judge.
For the appellant: Mr. Shiv Pal Manhans, Senior Panel Counsel.

For respondents No. 1, 2, 3(a) to 3(d): Mr. Ajay Kumar, Senior Advocate, with Mr.
Rohit Kumar, Advocate.

For respondents No. 4 & 5: None Sushil Kukreja, Judge The instant appeal filed by the appellant-General Manager, Northern Railway, who was respondent No. 6 before the learned Trial Court, under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act") against award dated 31.08.2011, passed by learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, District Una, H.P., in LAC Petition No. 06 of 2008, alongwith connected matters, 1 Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:HHC:10687-DB ) whereby the learned Trial Court enhanced the amount of land compensation.
2. Admittedly, the land of the claimants was situated in Up Mohal Teuri Duitiya Mohal Teuri, Tehsil and District Una, H.P., and it was acquired for public purpose, i.e., for construction of Nangal -Talwara Railway line, under the Land Acquisition Act (for short "the Act"), and to this effect notification was published under Section 4 of the Act on 01.12.2000.

Notification under Section 6 of the Act, dated 21.03.2001 was also issued and in sequel thereto objections were invited and thereafter the award was passed by the Land Acquisition Collector on 03.12.2001 under Section 11 of the Act.

The Land Acquisition Collector awarded the following compensation:
 Sr. Kind of the land Cost per kanal  No.
 1. Chahi Rs.12,005-00  2. Do Fasli Abbal Rs.7,829-40  3. Ek Fasli Abbal & Do Fasli Doam Rs.2,609-80

4 . Ek Fasli Doam Rs.4,263.15 General Manager vs Dev Rattani & Others on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86911490/
1  5. Banjar Kadim Jadid Rs.521-96  6. Kharkan Rs.1,043-92

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7 . Gair Mumkin Abadi -  8. Other Gair Mumkin - Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:HHC:10687-DB )

3. The claimants, being aggrieved, maintained a reference petition before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, H.P., i.e., LAC Petition No. 06/2008, seeking enhancement of the compensation amount, which was decided, vide impugned award dated 31.08.2011, whereby market value of the acquired land was re-determined @ Rs.80,000/- per kanal, on uniform basis,
irrespective of the classification and category of the land.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Indisputably, for the same acquisition proceedings, the appeal(s) arising out of similarly situated claimants, already stands decided by this Court, vide judgment dated 17.11.2017, in RFA No. 378 of 2012, titled as General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajneesh Kumar & others, as also RFA No.
693 of 2012, titled as General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajneesh Kumar & others, decided on 29.08.2018, and a bunch of Regular First Appeals, lead being RFA No. 236 of 2013, titled as General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajneesh Kumar & others, decided on 29.08.2018.
5.

sentences.text:
In the above backdrop, the instant appeal is squarely covered by the above decisions, as the issues Neutral Citation No. ( 2024:HHC:10687-DB ) involved in the instant appeal are identical, as in the decisions (supra) and this fact is not at all in dispute.
6.

In view of the above, the instant appeal is disposed of in terms of the aforesaid judgments and the directions, as given in the aforesaid decisions qua the determination of compensation, shall mutatis mutandis apply to the instant appeal as well.
The appeal stands disposed of in the aforesaid terms, as also the pending application(s), if any.

( Sushil Kukreja ) Judge 5th October, 2024 (virender)
